$comment: Machine-readable result of a semantic handoff review (pmo-delivery, intent handoff_review).
This file is CANDIDATE EVIDENCE, not an approval. An AI reviewer may record findings,
recommend a readiness stage, and close a finding when the documents show it was fixed.
It may not close a finding that needs a business, legal, security, or human decision,
and it may never move an approval row in PROJECT.md from pending to approved.
Freshness uses TWO digests, because a review goes stale two different ways:
source_snapshot.digest  the material the requirements came from changed
review_inputs.digest    a governed artifact the reviewer read changed
Get both with the handoffDigest tool (src/tools/digest-tools.ts)
Without the second digest, rewriting BUILD-SPEC after a review would leave it
Closure is enforced, not requested. A finding whose status is not `open` needs a
resolvable decision_ref. An AI reviewer may only set `resolved`, and may never close
a finding under a human-only lens (privacy classification, environment constraints)
whatever the decision reference says. See handoff-policy.json semantic_review.closure_policy.
Remove this $comment block in a real project file.

findings.description: <What is wrong, in one or two sentences. Do not quote source content.>
findings.suggestion: <The concrete change that would resolve it.>
findings.$decision_ref_note: Required by any status other than open. Must lead with a resolvable reference (DEC-###, ISSUE:n, FILE:path, URL:...).

recommendation.$comment: A recommendation, not a verdict. axiom handoff computes the stage verdicts; a human decides whether to act on them.
recommendation.notes: <One paragraph: what a reader most needs to know before acting on this review.>
